# West Winds by Creative Homes
> 136 luxury G+2 triplex villas on 10 acres in Bhanur, West Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

- Configurations: 3 BHK + Media room, 4 BHK + Media room
- Plot sizes: 170–300 sq.yds (17 layouts) · Built-up: 2,550–4,500 sq.ft · East & West facing
- Price: from ₹2.10 Cr (BSP); GST, stamp duty & mutation extra; corpus & 2-yr FMS ₹5 lakh
- Approvals: HMDA, RERA · Home loans: LIC & others · Possession: December 2026
- Location: Bhanur near Shankarpalli — 2 min BDL, 5 min Shankarpalli, 10 min Kollur ORR Exit 2, 15 min ORR Exit 3 / Patancheru, 20 min Kokapet / Neopolis, 25 min Gachibowli
